fragments: Democratic Byzantine Fault Tolerant (DBFT) consensus mechanism, developed and rigorously tested at the University of Sydney.
DBFT achieves consensus through a democratic process where no single node controls the outcome.
This means Redbelly maintains a single, consistent transaction record with no forking or branching
Participants verify their identities, but their privacy remains protected through zero-knowledge proofs.

fragments: Redbelly Mainnet is now LIVE!
has officially launched its Mainnet.
with the support of the University of Sydney, CSIRO's Data 61, and Block8

Redbelly is designed to meet the requirements of regulated financial markets, providing open infrastructure that enables institutions to issue, manage, and distribute digital financial assets at scale.
Redbelly is Digital Public Token Infrastructure
Verified participants enable full auditability and clear accountability across all transactions
A network of clean liquidity, combined with verifiable credentials enable tokenised investment products with defined investor eligibility, enforced at the point of trade.
Eligibility can be verified programmatically at the point of issuance and trade
Deterministic finality ensures transactions are confirmed once and cannot be reversed
Lower intermediaries and automate issuance, settlement and compliance
